resolution.note: Root cause: worker-scope matched /t-[a-z0-9]{7}/ inside any path or branch, so a lane worktree named verdict-evidence read 't-evidenc' as its task id; ids now stand alone (taskId). Baseline: failingTests reads the TAP location of a not-ok block, so the reason names the file and the flaky-rerun runs.

title: A red baseline names its failing tests, and worker-stop and worker-scope pass under full-suite load
body:
Why: lane verdict-evidence (t-vpks6m5) 18:19 refused a red baseline on clean main 4e5df85+ with reason 'npm test fails (exit 1: mise ERROR Run with --verbose ...)'; the real failures were two tests under full-suite load (test/claude/worker-stop.test.ts 'fix-x is blocked at Stop', test/claude/worker-scope.test.ts 'takes its Scope from the task record named by the branch') that pass alone, while the quoted line is a pnpm-store warning printed before the tests (log: .krn/worktrees/ve-test.log, lines 7-9, 2133, 5037).
Outcome: the baseline refusal names the failing test files and titles, never a preamble warning; the two tests pass under the full suite (find the shared state they race on).
Proof: a lane-run unit test with a preamble warning and one failing test asserts the stop line names the test; npm test green twice in a row on the host.
